text:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to onboard 'oregon-4b-compact' into the model-catalog tomorrow during the 02:00-02:30 UTC quiet window. Need owners for smoke, rollback, and metrics watch. Plan: pin variant v2 -> deploy to staging -> canary -> alias swap. Expect ~30m end-to-end.

Eli: I can own smoke. I'll run the smoke script and the tokenized latency check. Can you confirm the pinned artifact name and the quant profile?

Maya: Artifact is model-catalog/oregon-4b-compact:v2-2026-03-19. Quant profile: q4_1 (recommended). Smoke command: `./ops/smoke/run_smoke.sh --model oregon --quiet`. Will coordinate canary pin after staging passes.

Sanjay: I'll own rollback readiness + runbook. Proposed rollback triggers: quality regression >5% on eval set OR latency P95 > 200ms for canary. I'll prepare `scripts/rollback_to_alias.sh` and a short checklist. Will open the PR with runbook and commands.

Eli: Please drop the PR link here when ready. Also we need canary capacity reserved — @DeployBot can you reserve 2 dedicated slots in iad for the window (30m)?

DeployBot: deploy-bot: Reservation request received from @Eli. Reserving 2 slots in iad for project 'catalog-onboard' at 02:00 UTC for 30 minutes. Reservation ID: res-4312. Notifying OpsOncall.

OpsOncall: Ack. I'll watch tracing, error rates, and per-route SLOs. If we hit >1% error or any spike in RL error rates, tag me and I'll flip fallback.

Xi: Quick question — does the catalog alias swap require a KV cache invalidation that forces prod restart? Trying to understand impact for other teams.

Maya: No prod restart. We invalidate prefix cache via admin endpoint: `POST /admin/cache/invalidate` with body `{ "prefix": "oregon-v1" }`. That can be performed right after alias swap.

Sanjay: Rollback job prep notes (I'll attach in PR): make sure to run `scripts/rollback_to_alias.sh <previous-alias>` and then run a smoke run against staging before promoting. I'll test the script on staging and post the PR ~10m before the window.

Eli: Smoke checklist (automated + manual):
1) `curl -fsS https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/ping` returns 200
2) `./tools/gen_sample.py --model oregon --tokens 256` — compare logits/sample qual
3) run latency probe: `./tools/latency_probe --model oregon --rps 20 --duration 60` and log P50/P95/P99
4) quick human review: 5 prompts from eval set for style/regressions

Eli: Quick snippet for automated check: ```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
./ops/smoke/run_smoke.sh --model oregon --output /tmp/smoke.json
python ./tools/analyze_smoke.py /tmp/smoke.json --thresholds p95:200ms,error_rate:0.01
```

Maya: Thanks — if no objections I'll merge the catalog PR at 01:50 UTC and tag owners. I'll also post the canary alias and reservation ID in the deploy channel. :thumbsup:

Eli: :thumbsup: I'll be on call during the window and will post results in this thread.

OpsOncall: On standby. Will watch traces and kick fallback if needed.

Maya: Great — moving forward unless someone raises a blocker before 01:40 UTC.
